items.judul: Information for New Students for the Semester of the 2025/2026
items.isi: New students are advised to regularly check the online schedule for filling out the Study Plan Card (KRS) for the first semester of the 2025/2026. Bank payment data will be pulled once the registration period is officially open
Use the academic calendar feature to stay updated on all class activities
To access SSO or Unhas email, students should log in using their NeoSIA username and password. If you need to reset NeoSIA password, please reach out to the admin of your study program.
